caption: New event form with the default settings: people outside the workspace get Viewer access, and a first session is already scheduled for the same day, Saturday 31 October 2026 at 5:00 PM. The account name and email are hidden.
Straight after creation the test event is 'Upcoming', with a registration page and 1 attendee on the session; there was no draft step. The account name is hidden.
People tab of the new event: 1 registrant, and that registrant is the account owner, added automatically; the owner's name and email are hidden.
Export your registrants: Excel, CSV or ODS, and the button is 'Request export' rather than a direct download; the owner's name and email are hidden.
Email invites tab: 0 invitations and the 'Invite contacts' buttons greyed out, so we found no way to add registrants by hand; the account avatar is hidden.
Billing on the free plan: 30 attendee credits, sessions up to 30 minutes and 30 credits included per year, with the Pro plan at €2.50 per attendee below; the account avatar is hidden.
